```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 2.8, fig.height = 4.6, dpi = 300)
library(readr); library(dplyr); library(ggplot2); library(emmeans)
library(knitr); library(kableExtra)
```

# Overview

Panel **Fig2F** (P45 — GC count per HPF (IGL)) regenerated in R directly from the lab's GraphPad
Prism source values (consolidated CSV: `data/Fig2_AE_data.csv`, panel
`E`). One-way ANOVA across the four groups, followed by pairwise
contrasts via `emmeans` with `adjust = "tukey"` (matches the post-hoc
used in the published Prism analysis).

# Data

```{r load}
dat <- read_csv("data/Fig2_AE_data.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(Panel == "E") |>
  mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Sal-N","Sal-Hx","LPS-N","LPS-Hx")))

dat |> count(Group, name = "n") |>
  kable(caption = "Replicates per group (Fig2F)") |>
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

# Statistics

```{r stats}
stars <- function(p) ifelse(p < 1e-4, "****",
                     ifelse(p < 1e-3, "***",
                     ifelse(p < 1e-2, "**",
                     ifelse(p < 5e-2, "*", "ns"))))

fit <- aov(Value ~ Group, data = dat)
anova_tab <- summary(fit)[[1]]
emm <- emmeans(fit, "Group")
ph  <- as.data.frame(pairs(emm, adjust = "tukey")) |>
         mutate(sig = stars(p.value))

anova_tab |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Source") |>
  kable(digits = 4, caption = "One-way ANOVA") |>
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

ph |>
  kable(digits = 4,
        caption = sprintf("Pairwise contrasts (Tukey HSD)")) |>
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

# Figure

```{r plot, fig.width=2.8, fig.height=4.6}
fill_cols <- c("Sal-N"="#DCE3EF","Sal-Hx"="#9DB0CB","LPS-N"="#41608F","LPS-Hx"="#D9D9D9")

summ <- dat |> group_by(Group) |>
  summarise(mean = mean(Value), sd = sd(Value),
            top  = max(Value) + sd(Value), .groups = "drop")

sig_pairs <- ph |> filter(p.value < 0.05)
lev <- levels(dat$Group)
sig <- if (nrow(sig_pairs)) do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(sig_pairs)), function(i) {
  gs <- strsplit(as.character(sig_pairs$contrast[i]), " - ")[[1]]
  gs <- gsub("^\\(|\\)$", "", gs)
  data.frame(x = which(lev == gs[1]), xend = which(lev == gs[2]), lab = sig_pairs$sig[i])
})) else NULL

span <- 1500; step <- span * 0.065
base <- max(summ$top) + step * 0.7
y_top <- 1500
if (!is.null(sig)) { sig$y <- base + (seq_len(nrow(sig)) - 1) * step
                     y_top <- max(y_top, max(sig$y) + step) }

set.seed(7)
p <- ggplot(summ, aes(Group, mean)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = Group), width = 0.62, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd),
                width = 0.22, linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_point(data = dat, aes(Group, Value, fill = Group),
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, seed = 7),
             size = 1.6, shape = 21, colour = "black", stroke = 0.3,
             show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_cols) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, y_top),
                     breaks = seq(0, 1500, 500), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(title = "P45", x = NULL, y = "GC count per HPF (IGL)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(legend.position  = "none",
        plot.title       = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
        plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA))

if (!is.null(sig)) for (i in seq_len(nrow(sig))) {
  yy <- sig$y[i]
  p <- p +
    annotate("segment", x = sig$x[i],    xend = sig$xend[i], y = yy, yend = yy, linewidth = 0.3) +
    annotate("segment", x = sig$x[i],    xend = sig$x[i],    y = yy, yend = yy - step * 0.18, linewidth = 0.3) +
    annotate("segment", x = sig$xend[i], xend = sig$xend[i], y = yy, yend = yy - step * 0.18, linewidth = 0.3) +
    annotate("text", x = (sig$x[i] + sig$xend[i]) / 2, y = yy + step * 0.05,
             label = sig$lab[i], vjust = 0, fontface = "bold", size = 3.6)
}

p

ggsave("Fig2F.pdf", p, width = 2.6, height = 4.4, device = cairo_pdf)
ggsave("Fig2F.png", p, width = 2.6, height = 4.4, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
